limits: Source-shell containment and disjoint polygons establish a consistent drawing, not actual apartment positions, dimensions, doorways, or floor elevations.
Every room area in this report is a gross geometric allocation area. No net, rental, measured clear-area, or 16.4m² fit claim is made.

Only recorded doors create access edges. Missing stair connections are an explicit incomplete-model finding and must not be concealed by inventing a doorway.

Unassigned wings, low-roof margins, and the unresolved House 59 east bank are not silently counted as apartments.

summary.meaning: Counts sum separate floor hypotheses, not unique verified apartments or residents. Numerical consistency does not resolve shape, inventory, or access evidence gaps.
